blocks.text: PARIS — France was reeling from widespread destruction after violent protests over the cost of living left streets littered with burned-out cars, smashed shop windows and looted stores. Authorities said about 1,800 people had been arrested nationwide, while hundreds of police officers, firefighters and paramedics were reported hurt.
